text:
Situation: Mesna 100 mg/mL 10 mL vials are in limited supply at both campuses. Corvale East holds 73 vials at 3.3 per day, providing 22.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds 43 vials at 2.7 per day, providing 15.7 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show mesna is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at East and two weeks at General. No national shortage is declared, but campus-level days on hand are low enough to warrant proactive purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Sagent Pharmaceuticals (plant: SAGENT PHARMS INC.); requires P&T committee approval.
2. If Sagent cannot fulfill, buyer places purchase order with Bamboo US Bidco LCC; requires P&T committee approval.
3. If needed, buyer places purchase order with Baxter Healthcare Company; requires P&T committee approval.
4. If needed, buyer places purchase order with Eugia US LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
5. If needed, buyer places purchase order with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying reorder until stock falls below seven days at either campus.
